subject: Vertice

subject: Cato
object: €6M seed to bring AI to public tenders
source_quote: The good news is that Europe’s bureaucratic complexity, for once, works in our favour: 27 procurement regimes and thousands of portals are a nightmare for founders to navigate and a moat for whoever automates them. A US competitor cannot shortcut its way through Italian tender law. The test to watch is the one Cato has set itself – whether a system trained on Italy’s €309.7bn tender market travels to the next country, where the documents, deadlines and evaluation grids all change shape. Seed-stage playbooks for that jump are well documented in our Series A funding playbook ; execution is the hard part.
